title: IndexedRows::clone keeps the source's persistence identity, so a restored writable clone could skip metadata capture
outcome: A writable clone of a retained test-run history store (IndexedRows in src/test_run_history_store.rs) gets its own persistence identity, so restoring a saved clone and then mutating it can never present the same identity and generation as an already-captured, different version of the rows; metadata capture always records the restored store's changes.
acceptance: IndexedRows::clone keeps the source's persistence identity, so a restored writable clone could skip metadata capture is done
